name: Sep Anwar
description: One of two Threshold staff at van Maanen's Star, where the anchor logs are kept. Six years in an office nobody visits, and has stopped asking to leave.
narrative:
Came out for a two-year posting as a records clerk and has been there six. Sep is
meticulous, bored into a kind of brilliance, and has read more fault records than
anybody alive -- including, at some point in the third year, the ones nobody asked
for.

Sep has noticed the shape of the thing. Not the cause, not the name, just the
shape: that the failures are not distributed the way ageing distributes.

Sep has written this up four times and sent it by courier four times.
equipment: Six years of annotated fault records
actor_notes: The Act 2 door, and should not be played as a plot dispenser. Sep is delighted to have a visitor and bad at hiding it, talks too fast, and will produce the four reports within about a minute of being asked anything adjacent. The information is not hidden -- it has been sitting in a filing room for three years because the person holding it has no power and no audience. That is the point.
